title: Half the cards get double weight
hook: Keeping half the items changes how much each survivor represents.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Compact a sorted sketch level by retaining one parity and doubling retained weights.

misconception: Discarding half the observations necessarily halves their represented mass.
objective: Compact a sorted sketch level by retaining one parity and doubling retained weights.

claims.text: Compaction retains one value per adjacent sorted pair and doubles its weight. Total represented mass is preserved, while a threshold’s estimated rank can move. The parity is disclosed; randomized sketches choose parity rather than always preferring low values.
